Standard: Design protections to prevent catastrophic and critical hazards during nominal operation, as well as in the presence of single failures and failure combinations, are incorporated in the VCF and verified to support the failure response and PLOC requirements in 6.2.1.1 – 6.2.1.3. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) The VCF subsystem and SHA are reviewed for completeness IAW with the SSPP for the following: a. Hazards identified and assessed for completeness. b. Causal factors established and reviewed for completeness. c. Mitigating controls are established and reviewed for their effectiveness in hazard mitigation. d. Requirements for the mitigating controls are in place and allocated appropriately to the hardware, software, or system level, with traceability to verification methods.
(2) For mitigating controls verified by analysis, the analysis demonstrates successful hazard closure evidence.
(3) Open hardware and software deficiencies for the VCF and integrated subsystems are analyzed to ensure they do not result in VCF hazards that cannot be mitigated to risk levels specified by the procuring activity. Any mitigating limitations or procedural workarounds (e.g., envelope limits, procedural limits, warnings, cautions, notes) have been documented, agreed to by the procuring activity SMEs, and communicated to the flight crew. Test.
  (1) Lab test: For mitigating controls verified by test, test results demonstrate successful hazard closure evidence.
